seo.title: Dashboards and Data Visualization
seo.description: Turn raw product events into charts. Funnels, retention, time series, Sankey diagrams, histograms, maps, and more, all in real time.

hero.heading: From events to charts - in real time
hero.subheading: Build dashboards with funnels, retention curves, time series, Sankey diagrams, and maps. No SQL, no data team required.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about data visualization and analytics dashboards in OpenPanel.

items.question: What chart types does OpenPanel support?
items.answer: Eleven: Linear, Bar, Histogram, Pie, Metric, Area, Map, Funnel, Retention, Conversion and Sankey. They all come out of the same report builder, so you can switch the type and keep the events, filters and breakdowns.

items.question: Do I need to write SQL to build charts?
items.answer: No. Pick the events, a metric, a breakdown and a chart type. Formulas (B / A) cover rates and ratios. There is no SQL editor; if you want to ask a question in words, use the built-in chat or connect your own AI through MCP.

items.question: Can I share dashboards with my team?
items.answer: Yes. Invite as many members as you like, or share a dashboard or a single report as a public link, with an optional password.

items.question: How often do charts update?
items.answer: As events arrive. There is no sampling and no nightly batch; a report shows every event up to the moment you open it.

items.question: What is a Sankey diagram?
items.answer: A Sankey diagram is a flow visualization that shows how users move through your product. Each path is drawn as a flow between steps, so you can see common journeys, unexpected branches, and exit points at a glance.

items.question: Can I use retention and funnel charts together?
items.answer: Yes. You can build funnels to find where users drop off and retention charts to see if the users who do convert come back. Combining both gives you a complete picture of activation and engagement.
